anchors.company: LuxExperience B.V. (formerly MYT Netherlands Parent B.V.; owns Mytheresa / NET-A-PORTER / MR PORTER / YOOX)
anchors.event_window: Full-year FY2026 earnings report, before market open, Wednesday 2026-09-16 (session: bmo), 8:00am ET call
anchors.spot_as_of: 2026-09-15 (anchor packet handed to the panel; see spot_correction_note)
anchors.spot_correction_note: The anchor value of $7.83 handed to the panel turned out to be stale/wrong. Four of the seven personas (options-positioning, fundamental, sentiment, macro-peers), independently and unprompted, sourced real-time quotes of $7.15-7.18 as of 2026-09-15 (stockanalysis.com, finviz.com, marketbeat.com) -- roughly 8-9% lower. This is the corrected, more reliable spot for the dossier header: ~$7.16, as-of 2026-09-15. The persona direction/probability scores are unaffected (all personas reasoned in percentage-move space against the historical series, not against a dollar target), but the displayed run-in (e.g. 20-day return, distance to 52-week low) should use $7.16, not $7.83.
anchors.spot_corrected_source: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/luxe/, https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=LUXE, https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/LUXE (cross-checked by 4 independent persona subagents on 2026-09-15)
anchors.implied_move_source: UNAVAILABLE -- no functioning options market in LUXE (confirmed independently by all seven personas: MarketBeat reports 'Optionable: N/A'; zero bids on nearly every contract; 95 contracts of open interest in the front expiry). This is a market-structure fact, not a staleness issue -- carried forward unchanged from stage 2.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±9-12% absolute, in line with the 10.4% mean |move| of the last 8 prints. Nothing is option-priced, so there is no implied bar to fade; what IS priced is the de-rating. A merely in-line FY26 does NOT require a beat to hold the stock flat -- the bar has already been cut to it. The stock-moving variable is the first FY27 guide, which is genuinely two-sided.
key_drivers: FY26 guidance is very likely to be MET, not missed: 9M GMV of ~EUR1,927.5m needs only EUR572.5m in Q4 vs EUR653.7m printed in Q3; on adj EBITDA, the low end of the -1%/+1% margin band is already cleared with a quarter to go.

The metric this trades on is NOT the -$0.11 consensus EPS (GAAP is corrupted by the YNAP bargain-purchase gain). It is group FY26 adjusted EBITDA margin landing positive, and the first formal FY27 margin guide versus the reiterated medium-term EUR4bn / 7-9% bridge.

Segment mix is the quiet positive: gross margin is expanding across all three segments (Mytheresa +240bp, NAP/MR PORTER +700bp, YOOX +620bp) while the two acquired ones still shrink top-line. Balance sheet is debt-free with EUR436.1m cash against a ~$981m market cap.
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: The FY27 initial guide, not the Q4 print. If FY27 comes in at a low-single-digit margin or a wide 'transformation continues' range, the stock sells off hard on an otherwise in-line FY26 -- and the fully diluted share count was corrected from ~87m to ~140m, so any 'beat' is divided by a bigger denominator than older models assumed.
panel_verdicts.counter_case_if_wrong: EUR436.1m of net cash is ~44% of market cap; a buyback, a Mytheresa-standalone sum-of-parts framing, or a disposal signal on YOOX can lift this 10%+ against a soft P&L -- this name gaps on narrative, not on EPS.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Could not source Q4 FY25 group (post-YNAP) net sales; Q4/FY26 free cash flow and inventory; short interest and float; any Q4 GMV pre-announcement. Spot per the anchor (~$7.83) conflicts with stockanalysis.com's $7.15 quote.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: No option-implied move exists -- confirmed structurally, not as staleness. 1SD roughly ±9-11%, anchored on realised history (mean 10.44%, median 8.53%) as a floor, not a cap. A ~230k-share ADV book reprices in a handful of orders, which is why this name has printed +23.8% and -11.8% moves.
key_drivers: No options market at all -- zero dealer gamma, zero implied anchor; the fat-tailed realised-move history is partly a liquidity artifact of thin ADV.

Short interest ~3.96m shares / ~22.5% of float (per stockanalysis), dead flat since April -- no fresh bear build into the print, but days-to-cover 31.6-47.2. Blunted by only ~10% institutional ownership -- few natural buyers to squeeze into.
Drawdown, not run-up, into the print: down ~3.5-4% on the session before the print, the session after the CFO made his bull case at a Goldman Sachs conference -- the trade is neglected, not crowded.
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: This is the initial FY27 guide, the classic gap-down event. The May print was the identical setup (adj EBITDA beat, guidance confirmed) and the stock still fell 11.8% on the revenue line. Richemont's 33% post-lockup stake stands as a cap on any rally.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Implied move, IV, skew, put/call, dealer gamma all structurally absent. Short interest as-of 2026-08-31, ~2 weeks stale. Days-to-cover conflicts by source (31.6 vs 47.2). Spot conflicts with the anchor: three independent sources show ~$7.15-7.18 versus the handed $7.83.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Expect a large move, ±9-14%; with no options market nothing is priced in a vol sense, and the ~-6% one-month drift has already discounted a soft quarter, so the asymmetry skews to a violent upside pop on a merely OK number.
key_drivers: No retail crowd at all -- zero sourceable Reddit/StockTwits/X chatter, 125k share ADV, no options market. This is an abandoned name, not a hyped one.

The crowd here is professional and short: ~3.96m shares short, ~22.5% of the small ADS float, 31-34 days to cover, flat month-over-month -- shorts are pressing, not covering, and every short must cover in the cash stock with no options to hedge into.

Tone drifted UP while price drifted DOWN over 30 days -- TD Cowen raised PT $8->$9 in mid-August; CFO pre-briefed favourable segment margins at Goldman Sachs on Sep 14, ~36 hours before the print. Managements about to miss do not pre-brief segment margins two days early.
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: This is the full-year print, so FY27 guidance lands with it, and the bull narrative is entirely a timeline narrative (NAP profitable FY27, YOOX FY28). Any slip in that schedule and a 22%-of-float short book plus the Richemont stake out of lockup means rallies get sold as hard as they run.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Could source NO direct retail/social data for LUXE. Could not reconcile the spot conflict: finviz/stockanalysis show $7.15-7.17 today against the handed anchor of ~$7.83.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Base rate says ±9-12% absolute, and with no options market literally nothing is priced. Mean |move| 10.4%, median 8.5% over 8 prints. The post-YNAP entity is WIDER, not narrower -- but the two fiscal-Q4/full-year prints in the sample are the two smallest moves in it (+1.17%, +3.06%), because guidance was already confirmed in May.
key_drivers: Raw 8-quarter directional base rate is 6 up / 2 down, but splits across a structural break: the last 3 prints (post-YNAP consolidation) are 1 up / 2 down -- two incompatible base rates on n=8 and n=3, hence Low confidence and near 50/50.
Q4/full-year prints specifically: 2 of 2 up and both tiny -- the quietest print of this name's year, and the only cohort that matches tomorrow's event type.
Setup cohort: run-DOWN not run-up into the print, ~-6.6% over 20 days -- beaten-down-into-the-print is the one conditional that leans mildly positive.
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: This name sells off on the top line regardless of profitability wins -- the May-2026 precedent is exact and recent (adjusted EBITDA beat, guidance confirmed, stock still closed -11.8% because net sales missed by ~6%). Q4 is where FY27 guidance gets introduced, and a base rate cannot see a guide.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Per-quarter attribution to the 8 supplied moves corroborated for only 2 of 8. No current short interest cohort, no sector/size base rate exists for a comparable name.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Roughly 9-13% close-to-close. Nothing is priced in the usual sense; the realised-move history understates this event because the measurement window contains the Sept 16 2:00pm ET FOMC decision and dot plot. Skew is to the downside.
key_drivers: The Fed, not the print, owns this session: ~90.7% odds of the first hike since 2023, landing inside the close-to-close window of a thin, unprofitable, high-duration micro-cap name, against an already risk-off tape (Russell 2000 -0.93%).

Peer prints say good quarters get sold in this sub-sector: Richemont's Q4-equivalent quarter was +20% cc and shares still fell 1-2%; Revolve beat both lines and fell ~6.3%; Burberry's miss drew -7.27% pre-market.
Management pre-released the number the bulls wanted two days early at Goldman Sachs -- removing upside surprise capacity and setting up a sell-the-news.
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: A 90%-priced hike is precisely the setup where the risk is a dovish surprise -- if framed as one-and-done, small-cap discretionary rips at 2pm regardless of the print, and confirmation that NAP/MR PORTER hit breakeven would be a first-ever structural milestone that re-rates the story even on soft reported sales.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Could not source current consensus for Q4 FY26, current short interest (only a year-stale figure), or the precise 20-day run-up.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±9-12% central, with a live tail to ±20%. A small effective float plus ~3.96m shares short at 34-47 days to cover means the price response is mechanically non-linear -- I would not fade a large gap in either direction as overdone.
panel_verdicts.consensus_view_as_i_read_it: Cautious / show-me, tilting negative: -21.9% over 52 weeks, below both the 50-day and 200-day averages, targets cut from $10.38 to $9.25, Q4 consensus a loss. FY26 guidance was already reaffirmed in May, so the plain expectation is an in-line, unexciting FY26 close with FY27 guidance the only thing that matters.
panel_verdicts.strongest_reversal_case: The bar is low and the quarter reported was the best luxury quarter in two years (Richemont +20% cc, Americas +27%). Management pre-signalled at Goldman Sachs on 09-14 that FY26 landed fine. A clean FY26 close plus a credible first FY27 guide meets a tape with ~3.96m shares short, 34-47 days to cover, EUR436.1m cash and zero debt, and a precedent of +23.8%/+21.1% gaps.
panel_verdicts.what_would_break_my_reversal_case: An FY27 guide on a reported basis showing top-line declining, paired with a full-year net loss well above the 9M figure and year-end cash materially below EUR436.1m -- that reframes 'transformation on track' as 'paying to shrink'.
key_drivers: FY27 guidance is the entire event -- FY26 was pre-signalled at Goldman on 09-14
Reported-basis optics: Outnet gone, YOOX deliberately shrinking, EUR200-250m restructuring spend to 2028
Mechanical squeeze/gap risk: tiny effective float, no options market to absorb flow
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: The market already heard this exact bull case at Goldman on 09-14 and the stock still closed down ~4% the next session. If the print merely confirms the conference, 'sell the news' is at least as likely as the squeeze.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No formal FY27 guidance exists yet. Float is genuinely disputed across sources. No options market, so no implied move to sanity-check history against.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±9-14%, at or above the 8.5% historical median. Nothing is priced in in any meaningful sense -- no options market, no dealer flow to dampen the gap. Left tail is fatter than the right on a guidance re-base with no liquidity floor under it.
panel_verdicts.insider_signal: None found, and the absence is itself the finding: zero Form 4s in the six months Section 16 has applied to this foreign private issuer -- no insider buying and no insider selling. CEO Michael Kliger owns zero ordinary shares outright, his entire economic interest is options/RSUs, two of his largest tranches underwater at spot. A Form 144 by Kliger filed 2026-02-11 predates Section 16 and its share count could not be retrieved.
panel_verdicts.communication_signal: Two shifts pointing opposite ways: (1) CFO presented at Goldman Sachs 48 hours pre-print with FY26 fully known to him, disclosing segment margins and reaffirming the EUR4bn/7-9% target 'without qualification' -- unusual cadence that historically precedes an in-line-or-better print. (2) A live disclosure-quality flag: the Q2 FY26 release was re-issued as 'CORRECTING and REPLACING' after misstating weighted-average share count by ~60%, an unresolved reporting-control flag going into the first full-year post-acquisition print.
key_drivers: Zero Form 4s even as the CFO publicly calls the stock undervalued; CEO owns no common stock
CFO on a Goldman stage 48h pre-print volunteering segment margin -- rare cadence, not typical of a management about to disappoint
Offsetting: unresolved share-count restatement flag; stock has run ~+12% into the event
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: The FY27 guide, which no forensic signal can see. If FY27 pushes NAP/MRP profitability out or a YNAP goodwill impairment lands with the audited full year, the stock is down 15-25% and the pre-print conference reads as the setup rather than the tell.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Could not source the Form 144 share count/value (SEC 503), current short interest/borrow fee (year-stale reading only), or any current Google Trends/web-traffic series.
